title: The Ticket That Was Not Lost

paragraphs.en: On the first morning of the Inventory, Mei Chen found a bottle of acid beside the museum's copper counter. Someone had spilled a little of it on an old assembly notice, leaving a pale hole in the paper. She set down her broom and examined the damage. Outside, a silver square hovered above the street, announcing that every object without a registered owner would become public game property at midnight. Mei was thirty-one and worked with museum records, not weapons. She had never imagined that a missing label could turn an ordinary street into a battlefield.
paragraphs.zh: 「清冊遊戲」開始的第一個早晨，陳玫在博物館的銅製櫃檯旁發現一瓶酸液。有人將少量酸液灑在舊集會公告上，紙張因此破了一個泛白的小洞。她放下掃帚檢查損傷。街上浮著一塊銀色方框，宣布午夜前沒有登記主人的物品，都會變成遊戲的公共財產。三十一歲的陳玫負責博物館檔案，不會打鬥。她從未想過，少了一張標籤竟能把普通街道變成戰場。

paragraphs.en: The ministry called the new phenomenon a way to entertain the city while testing ownership. A bright slogan promised, "Find it first, keep it forever." A youthful volunteer repeated the words with a smile, but his uneasy facial expression suggested that he did not believe them. Behind him, workers tried to construct a route between two shaded doors. They would cooperate until a man wearing a shady gray badge ordered them to stop. His instructions sounded persuasive, yet they contained no explanation of who had authority to take the things people already used.
paragraphs.zh: 主管部門稱這個新現象是一場有趣的所有權測驗。醒目的標語寫著：「先找到，就永遠擁有。」一名年輕志工微笑著重複標語，但不安的臉部表情顯示他自己也不相信。身後的工人正努力在兩道陰暗的門之間建出一條通道。他們原本願意合作，直到一名戴著可疑灰色徽章的男子命令停工。他說得頗有說服力，卻始終沒有解釋誰有權拿走別人原本正在使用的東西。

paragraphs.en: Mei followed the noise to the old opera room. Onstage a comic actor pretended to be a coward who ran away whenever a prop fell. The audience tried to laugh, but the actor stopped when a silver ticket appeared on the curtain. It identified the room's grand piano as "unclaimed," although Mei had checked its usage only yesterday. A woman from the neighborhood still taught music there every Thursday. If the badge man could interfere with that lesson simply by naming the piano first, the game's rules were not a harmless performance.
paragraphs.zh: 陳玫循著聲音走進舊歌劇廳。台上一名喜劇演員假扮懦夫，每當道具掉落便轉身逃跑。觀眾勉強發笑，直到布幕上出現一張銀色領物單，演員才停下來。單上把三角鋼琴標成「無主」，但陳玫昨天才核對過它的使用紀錄。附近仍有一名女士每週四來這裡教音樂。若戴徽章的人能靠搶先報名就干涉那堂課，這場遊戲絕不是無害的表演。

paragraphs.en: She read the smaller print beneath the silver ticket. There were three rules. First, a claim needed evidence of the object's last real use. Second, two independent witnesses could freeze a transfer until review. Third, a correction entered in the public archive could be challenged but never erased. The same rules applied to every ticket, even one issued by the game itself. Mei photographed the text, wrote down the clock time, and asked the music teacher to describe her last lesson. She refused to invent details the teacher could not remember.
paragraphs.zh: 她讀了銀色領物單下方的細字。規則有三條。第一，領物申請必須提出物品最近一次真實使用的證據。第二，兩名互相獨立的見證人可以暫停移轉，等待複核。第三，登進公共檔案的更正可以遭到質疑，卻不能被抹除。這些規則適用於每張領物單，包括遊戲自己發出的單子。陳玫拍下文字，記下時間，請音樂老師描述最後一次授課；對方記不起的細節，她沒有擅自補上。

paragraphs.en: An elderly cleaner named Han offered to be the second witness. Mei hesitated. A signature from an employee might be dismissed as a favor, even though Han had independently seen the same lesson. She asked him to describe the sound he remembered before showing him the teacher's account. Han recalled one stubborn note that refused to stay in tune. The teacher had written exactly that complaint on a repair request. Their two descriptions agreed without being copied. The silver ticket changed from red to amber, and the piano remained in the hall.
paragraphs.zh: 年長的清潔員韓叔願意成為第二名見證人。陳玫有些猶豫：員工簽名容易被當成私下幫忙，儘管韓叔確實獨立目睹了同一堂課。她先請韓叔描述記得的聲音，沒有讓他看老師的說明。韓叔記起一個老是走音的音符；老師也在維修申請上寫過完全相同的抱怨。兩份敘述相符，卻不是互相抄寫。銀色領物單從紅變琥珀色，鋼琴暫時留在原處。

paragraphs.en: The teacher unlocked a drawer and spread out the Thursday lesson cards. Six families had places in that free class. Mei compared the dates with her museum register while Han pressed the worn pedal and listened to the same uneven note. She asked the teacher to keep the cards beside the piano until a reviewer arrived. Han would watch the door; Mei would copy the rule for the other teachers. The gray badge could take the room from them only if nobody answered its claim.
paragraphs.zh: 老師打開抽屜，攤開週四的上課卡。六個家庭的孩子在這堂免費課都有名額。陳玫把日期與博物館登記簿比對，韓叔則踩下磨損的踏板，聽見同樣不準的音。她請老師把卡片留在鋼琴旁，等候審查者。韓叔看守大門，陳玫則替其他老師抄寫規則。灰徽章的人要拿走教室，得趁無人回應申領才辦得到。

paragraphs.en: The man with the gray badge returned and called Han a coward for hiding behind paperwork. Mei did not argue about courage. She pointed to the printed rule and asked the man to give his name for the review record. He walked away without answering. No one celebrated. The teacher still had to prove what had happened to the other instruments before midnight, and many neighbors did not even know the review rule existed. Mei cleared a corner of the counter and put up a sign: PUBLIC LOST-AND-FOUND RECORDS. The first ticket in her new archive was for something that had never been lost.
paragraphs.zh: 戴灰色徽章的男子回來，罵韓叔是躲在文件後面的懦夫。陳玫沒有和他爭論勇氣，只指著印好的規則，請對方留下姓名以供複核。男子沒有回答便離開了。沒有人慶祝。音樂老師仍得在午夜前證明其他樂器的去向，而且許多鄰居根本不知道複核條款存在。陳玫清出櫃檯一角，掛上「公共失物檔案」的牌子。她的新檔案館收到的第一張領物單，屬於一件從來不曾遺失的物品。

questions.question: Which detail was actually checked in this chapter?
options: The piano pedal was worn and Thursday lesson cards were still in the drawer.
The station clock was made to ring after its recorded closing time.
Two dated receipts proved that the public kitchen remained in use.
questions.explanation: 本章記錄「鋼琴踏板已磨損，抽屜裡仍有週四上課卡」，這是有來源可以查核的事實，其餘選項不是本章的調查結果。

questions.question: What consequence did Mei try to prevent?
options: A customer should not have to publish her private life to confirm an order.
Mei might mistake hope for proof that her mother wished to return.
The music teacher could lose a free classroom that six families depended on.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「音樂老師可能失去六個家庭仰賴的免費教室」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

paragraphs.en: The next claim concerned a dog's collar. A child named Tao brought it to Mei with an elastic band tied around the buckle and a tiny paw carved into the metal. The game listed the animal as "property without an owner." Tao said his grandmother, an immigrant who ran a small bakery, had adopted the dog before he was born. She even kept an autograph from a famous dog trainer beside the old vaccination card, but the silver screen would accept only a current digital initial. Mei wondered who had decided that a signature written by hand was less trustworthy than a letter entered by a stranger.
paragraphs.zh: 第二件遭申領的東西是一條狗項圈。名叫陶陶的孩子把項圈拿來，上面扣著彈性帶，金屬片還刻有小小的爪印。遊戲把那隻狗列作「無主財產」。陶陶說，祖母是經營麵包店的移民，早在他出生前就領養了牠。她甚至在舊疫苗卡旁夾著一位知名訓犬師的親筆簽名，但銀色螢幕只肯接受目前的數位姓名縮寫。陳玫想知道，究竟是誰規定手寫簽名比陌生人輸入的字母更不可信。

paragraphs.en: A prominent merchant from the upper district arrived with two assistants. He said the dog would prosper in his garden and offered Tao money for the convenience of ending the dispute. His polished manner could not disguise the cruelty of treating a living animal like a prize. When Mei asked for evidence of his last contact with the dog, he made a rude remark about poor families. Tao's grandmother worked the evening shift and was not there to answer. Mei told the merchant that being busy was not proof of abandonment. Mei added a prevention note: a frozen claim did not permit anyone to move an animal without its caretaker.
paragraphs.zh: 上城區一位知名商人帶著兩名助手到場，說狗住進他的花園會過得更好，還提出給陶陶一筆錢，方便結束爭議。他舉止體面，卻無法掩飾把生命當作獎品的殘酷。陳玫請他提出最近接觸那隻狗的證據，他反而對貧困家庭說了難聽的話。陶陶的祖母值晚班，無法立刻到場。陳玫提醒商人，忙於工作不代表拋棄寵物。 陳玫補上預防說明：申領暫停期間，任何人都不得未經照護者同意移動動物。

paragraphs.en: Han showed Tao the printed timetable of the bakery deliveries. The dog walked with his grandmother before her first shift and slept by the back door afterward. A small camera had captured the routine. Mei warned that the recording might prevent a wrong claim, but it could not by itself prove the grandmother's identity. The child suggested asking a neighbor who always left water outside. That neighbor had no reason to favor the merchant or the family. Her careful feedback named the dog's favorite corner and the missing bell on its collar.
paragraphs.zh: 韓叔拿出麵包店送貨的時刻表。每天第一班前，狗都陪祖母散步，之後睡在後門邊。一台小相機拍過這段日常。陳玫提醒大家，影像有助預防錯誤申領，卻不能單憑它證明祖母的身分。陶陶建議找一位總在門外留水的鄰居。那位鄰居沒有理由偏袒商人或陶家。她仔細回饋，說出狗最愛待的角落，還提到項圈上少了一顆鈴鐺。

paragraphs.en: The merchant grew explosive when the review changed the ticket to amber. He claimed that challenging his privilege would ruin the neighborhood economy. Mei did not accuse him of mischief; she simply asked whether either assistant had seen the dog before this morning. Neither had. For the first time, Tao noticed the difference between people who repeated the same story and witnesses who could describe separate details. The game was not generous or cruel on its own. People could use its gaps for either purpose, and those choices needed names.
paragraphs.zh: 領物單轉為琥珀色時，商人勃然大怒，聲稱挑戰他的特權會毀掉地方經濟。陳玫沒有指控他惡作劇，只問兩名助手是否在今天早上之前看過那隻狗。兩人都沒有。陶陶第一次看懂：同聲複述故事的人，和能各自描述不同細節的見證人，並不相同。遊戲本身不會慷慨或殘酷；人們能利用它的漏洞做出不同選擇，而選擇應當留下姓名。

paragraphs.en: Tao turned the collar over on the counter. Its damaged bell loop had a rough edge which his grandmother had covered with the elastic band. The neighbor remembered bringing the band from her kitchen. Mei drew the broken loop and attached the drawing to the statement; the family photographs could stay in Tao's pocket. He chose one picture that showed the collar alone and refused to copy the others. Han put a bowl of water beneath the counter, where the dog could wait without becoming a display for the merchant's assistants.
paragraphs.zh: 陶陶把項圈翻到背面，放在櫃檯上。破損的鈴鐺環邊緣粗糙，祖母才用橡皮筋包住。鄰居記得那條橡皮筋是她從廚房拿來的。陳玫畫下斷環，附在證詞旁；家庭照片仍可留在陶陶口袋裡。他挑了一張只拍到項圈的照片，同意複印，其他的都不願公開。韓叔在櫃檯下放了一碗水，讓狗能等候，不必成為商人助手圍觀的展品。

paragraphs.en: When the grandmother arrived, the dog ran straight into her arms. Tao smiled, then stopped. A new silver notice appeared above the bakery: "Building entrance under review." The merchant's assistants had filed another claim while everyone watched the collar. Mei saw that winning a single case had not ended the threat; it had merely exposed a method. She asked Tao and his grandmother whether she could keep copies of their records. Both agreed, but only after Mei promised that the images would remain private unless they chose otherwise.
paragraphs.zh: 祖母趕到後，狗立刻撲進她懷裡。陶陶笑了，卻又停住：麵包店上方浮出新的銀色公告，寫著「建築入口待複核」。大家看項圈時，商人的助手已替店門另提申請。陳玫明白，贏下一案沒有消除威脅，只是揭露對方的方法。她徵求陶陶與祖母的同意，想保存紀錄副本。兩人同意，但陳玫必須承諾，除非他們自行決定，影像不會對外公開。

questions.question: What fact helped the team question the game notice?
options: The ice retreated after a small water leak was repaired.
The collar had a damaged bell loop that matched the grandmother’s account.
The postage record carried a name missing from the official list.
questions.explanation: 本章記錄「項圈鈴鐺環的破損和祖母的描述相符」，這是有來源可以查核的事實，其餘選項不是本章的調查結果。

questions.question: Why did the team insist on careful review?
options: Tao would have to decide whether to let strangers see his family’s private photographs.
Readers might lose books because absence of a record was treated as abandonment.
A blackout could make people surrender valuable records in panic.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「陶陶必須決定是否讓陌生人看見家人的私人照片」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

paragraphs.en: The bakery entrance was connected to a forgotten tunnel beneath a mountainous park. Mei brought Tao, Han, and a young surveyor named Lin to the locked barrier. Lin called the closure accidental; a clerk had entered the wrong number after last year's repair. But the lock was new, and its paint had not faded. Mei asked him to evaluate that difference before writing his report. They had seen how a simple claim could spread from an object to the place around it. This time they needed to know whether the tunnel had ever truly stopped serving the public.
paragraphs.zh: 麵包店入口連著一條被遺忘的山丘地下通道。陳玫帶著陶陶、韓叔和年輕測量員林遠來到鎖住的柵欄。林遠說封閉只是意外：去年修繕後，職員輸錯了編號。但門鎖很新，油漆也沒有褪色。陳玫請他先評估這個差異再寫報告。他們已看見一筆普通申領能如何蔓延至物品所在的地方；這次得查明通道是否真的停止供公眾使用。

paragraphs.en: Inside, a mild wind carried dust and the smell of wet stone. A fallen twig lay beside a line of emergency lights that blink at irregular intervals. Han remembered a brutal winter when the tunnel had sheltered families during a storm. Their gratitude was recorded in a wall painting, a composition of umbrellas and faces made by children. The painter had left a message beneath it: "Do not neglect the door just because the sun has returned." Mei copied the sentence, not as proof of legal ownership, but as evidence of what people once needed here. The team relied on shared intelligence, not on a secret warning that only one person could hear.
paragraphs.zh: 裡面有一陣微弱的風，夾著灰塵和潮石氣味。掉落的細枝旁，一排緊急燈不規律地閃爍。韓叔想起某個嚴酷的冬天，這條通道曾收容受暴風雨影響的家庭。孩子們畫了一幅由雨傘和人臉構成的壁畫，留下居民感激的記憶。畫家在下方寫道：「別因太陽回來，就忽略這扇門。」陳玫把句子抄下，但不是當作合法所有權證明，而是當成人們曾需要這裡的證據。 團隊仰賴共同蒐集的情報，不依賴只有一人能聽見的祕密警告。

paragraphs.en: An old speaker crackled. A voice announced that anyone who questioned the closure would be punished for offending the system. Tao looked frightened enough to choke on his words. Lin, who liked to quote a philosopher whenever he felt uncertain, began explaining why obedience might be safer. Mei stopped him gently. "There is a difference between a grave warning and an empty threat," she said. "Can the speaker tell us which written rule we broke?" The voice repeated its demand, but supplied no rule number. The threat was noise, not a verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 一具老舊擴音器響起雜音。有個聲音宣布，質疑封路的人都會因冒犯系統而受罰。陶陶害怕得幾乎說不出話。林遠一不安就喜歡引用哲學家的話，此時開始解釋服從也許更安全。陳玫溫和打斷他：「嚴重的警告和空洞的威脅不一樣。它能說出我們違反哪條明文規則嗎？」聲音不斷重複命令，卻報不出條號。那是噪音，不是判決。

paragraphs.en: They located a cabinet containing old repair cards. One card showed a design problem that had a tendency to recur: rainwater could collect near the lower steps. Another listed a proposed reform that would put the tunnel under shared maintenance. The documents did not support revenge against the officer who had closed it, and Mei did not want revenge. She wanted a working exit. She urged Lin to photograph the date stamps before anyone moved the cards. The fresh lock had been installed after the public repair request, not before it.
paragraphs.zh: 他們找到一個裝著舊維修卡的櫃子。有張卡記著容易反覆發生的設計問題：雨水會聚集在較低的階梯旁。另一張提出改革方案，要讓通道由多方共同維護。文件不能支持對封路官員的報復，陳玫也不想報復。她要的是能使用的出口。她催促林遠先拍下日期印章，再移動卡片。新鎖的安裝時間竟晚於公共修繕申請，而不是早於它。

paragraphs.en: Lin knelt beside the lock with a ruler. The unbroken paint on its bracket overlapped an older patch of repaired stone. Han held the lamp while Mei copied the repair card's date. Together these details gave Lin reason to withdraw his first explanation of an accidental closure. He crossed it out, signed the change, and left the old words readable. Tao asked whether they should force the barrier open. Lin checked the lower steps first and found water beneath a loose board. They would need a safe route before inviting the bakery's customers inside. Mei sent Han back to ask recent users for separate accounts; if none came forward, the tunnel might remain closed despite everything they had found. While they waited, Lin marked the wet step with a strip of cloth and began measuring a narrow path along the wall.
paragraphs.zh: 林跪在鎖旁，用尺測量。固定架上未破損的新漆蓋住一片較早修補過的石面。韓叔拿燈，陳玫抄下修繕卡日期。這些細節使林撤回最初意外封閉的解釋。他劃掉原文，簽名更正，舊字仍看得見。陶陶問是否該撬開障礙，林先檢查下方階梯，發現鬆木板下有水。他們得先找出安全路線，才能讓麵包店顧客進來。陳玫請韓叔回去尋找近期使用者，各自提供說法；若無人出面，即使有這些發現，通道也可能繼續封閉。等候時，林以布條標出濕階，開始測量牆邊的狹窄路線。

paragraphs.en: At the end of the tunnel, Lin discovered a narrow side gate with an old maintenance tag. A silver claim appeared immediately: "Gate abandoned." Mei asked Han and Lin to describe its last known use separately. Han remembered carrying supplies through it in the storm. Lin found a stamped delivery schedule from three months ago. Their accounts disagreed about the year but agreed that people had continued using the gate. Mei entered both dates, including the disagreement, and submitted the review. The claim froze. Through the gate, they saw the back wall of the municipal record office.
paragraphs.zh: 通道盡頭，林遠發現一扇窄側門，門上還掛著舊維護牌。銀色申領單立刻浮現：「側門已棄置。」陳玫請韓叔和林遠分開說明最近一次使用。韓叔記得風暴時曾搬物資經過；林遠則找到三個月前蓋章的送貨時刻表。兩人的年份說法不同，卻都證明門仍有人使用。陳玫連同分歧一起登錄、提出複核。申領暫停了。從側門望出去，他們看到市立檔案室的後牆。

questions.question: Which observation belonged in the evidence record?
options: Two similar sewing machines had different scratches and separate customer records.
The payment ledger named charges for editing public labels before the game began.
The lock was newer than the last public repair request.
questions.explanation: 本章記錄「門鎖安裝時間比最後一次公共修繕申請還晚」，這是有來源可以查核的事實，其餘選項不是本章的調查結果。

questions.question: What concern shaped the team’s decision?
options: Private addresses could be exposed if the hearing favored speed over care.
The tunnel might be closed forever if its recent users stayed silent.
Patients could lose a functioning clinic or have their medical privacy exposed.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「若近期使用者不說話，通道可能永遠關閉」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

title: The Letter That Refused to Vanish

paragraphs.en: The municipal record office smelled of paper and cold tea. A librarian named Nila welcomed Mei with earnest concern, not applause. She said the game had started taking possession of files whenever a shelf label faded. The staff had tried to accomplish the impossible task of checking every box by hand. One young researcher had made a joke to amuse the others: perhaps the records were learning to orbit the moon. Nobody laughed after the labels on three empty drawers began to bounce like balls in a machine.
paragraphs.zh: 市立檔案室有紙張與冷茶的味道。圖書館員妮拉帶著真切的憂慮迎接陳玫，沒有鼓掌。她說只要架上的標籤褪色，遊戲就開始取得檔案的占有權。職員努力靠人工完成逐箱清點這項幾乎不可能的任務。某位年輕研究員曾開玩笑逗大家開心，說檔案大概正學著繞月球運行；當三個空抽屜的標籤像球一樣彈跳時，再也沒人笑得出來。

paragraphs.en: Nila showed them a letter translated from another language, written by Mei's mother twenty years earlier. It concerned a missing shipment sent through an embassy. The translator had preserved the original margin notes rather than smoothing them into a neat story. One note said, "My approval is not consent to surrender the archive." Another contained an urgent request for two independent copies. Mei felt a continual tightening in her chest. Her mother had vanished from the municipal register last winter, yet this letter sounded more like a warning than a farewell.
paragraphs.zh: 妮拉拿出一封二十年前由陳玫母親寫成、後來翻譯成另一種語言的信。內容與經由大使館寄送卻遺失的貨物有關。譯者保留了原文的頁邊註記，沒有把它修整成整齊的故事。其中一段寫著：「我的核准不等於同意交出檔案。」另一段緊急要求保留兩份互相獨立的副本。陳玫胸口持續收緊。母親去年冬天從市民登記簿上消失了，可這封信聽起來更像警告，不像告別。

paragraphs.en: A city officer announced that all unregistered letters might belong to a murderer who had once worked in the building. Nila called the claim nonsense. Mei was disappointed by the officer's careless language, but she did not answer with anger. She asked whether there was a specific case number. There was none. The officer was trying to make the workers passive by frightening them with a crime that no one could verify. A careful record had more value than a dramatic accusation, especially when the person accused could not answer.
paragraphs.zh: 一名市府職員宣布，所有未登記的信件可能屬於曾在此工作的某名殺人犯。妮拉說這根本是一派胡言。陳玫對職員草率的說法很失望，卻沒有以憤怒回應；她問是否有具體案號，得到的答案是沒有。對方想用無法查證的罪名恐嚇大家，讓人被動服從。仔細保存的紀錄比戲劇性的指控更有價值，尤其當被指控的人無法答辯。

paragraphs.en: Mei placed the letter under a clear sheet. The emphasis in her mother's handwriting fell on the word "independent." The lower margin held a tiny rhyme used by archivists to remember which copy went where. Nila had kept a record of the receiving desk, including the day the letter arrived. The clerk on duty then had been a visiting researcher, not the officer's supposed criminal. They requested a formal review of the letter's status. The game displayed "pending," which was not victory, but it prevented immediate removal.
paragraphs.zh: 陳玫把信放在透明保護套下。母親筆跡中最強調的是「獨立」二字。頁腳還有一段押韻短句，是檔案員用來記憶副本流向的。妮拉保留了收件櫃檯的紀錄，連信送達的日期都記著。當年值班的是一名來訪研究員，根本不是職員口中的罪犯。大家正式申請複核信件的狀態。遊戲顯示「待處理」；這不是勝利，卻能阻止信件立刻遭到移走。

paragraphs.en: Nila brought the receiving book to the table and found the letter's arrival stamp. Mei laid her photograph beside it, leaving the original beneath its clear cover. The two copy instructions matched the entries in different columns of the book. One clerk reached for a box of letters, afraid the officer would return to take it. Nila stopped him at the shelf and wrote a receipt for the box instead. No one had authorized its removal. Mei wanted to ask whether her mother had stood at this same table, but the receiving book recorded a delivery, not a visit. She copied that distinction onto the back of her photograph before helping Nila check the next drawer.
paragraphs.zh: 妮拉把收件簿拿到桌上，找到信件的到件印記。陳玫把照片放在旁邊，原件仍留在透明護套下。兩份副本指示與簿上不同欄位的紀錄相符。一名職員怕官員回來取走信件，伸手想搬走一箱。妮拉在架旁攔住他，改替箱子開立保管收據，因為沒人核准移動。陳玫想問母親是否也站過這張桌前，但收件簿只記錄送達，不代表本人來訪。她在照片背面寫下這個區別，再幫妮拉檢查下一格抽屜。

paragraphs.en: That evening Mei resisted the wish to carry the letter home. If she treated it as a private treasure, she might repeat the very mistake she hoped to expose. She asked Nila to store the original and permitted only a dated photograph for her own investigation. A small group began checking the other drawers, one by one. They did not recover the whole archive. They did recover a method: protect the source, record who touched it, and let different witnesses speak before deciding what their words meant.
paragraphs.zh: 那晚陳玫忍住把信帶回家的衝動。若她把它當成私人物件，可能正好重犯自己想揭露的錯誤。她請妮拉妥善存放原件，只為調查拍一張有日期的照片。幾名職員開始逐一核對其他抽屜。他們沒有救回整座檔案室，卻找回一套方法：保護原件、記錄經手的人，讓不同見證人先各自說話，再判斷證詞代表什麼。

questions.question: Which finding mattered to the investigation?
options: The letter carried two independent copy instructions and a stamped arrival date.
A pair of page numbers was missing even from older public copies.
The gallery displayed disputed objects separately from their changing labels.
questions.explanation: 本章記錄「信上記有雙份獨立副本的指示及蓋章收件日期」，這是有來源可以查核的事實，其餘選項不是本章的調查結果。

questions.question: What risk made the review important?
options: A paperwork dispute could delay drinking water during a real storm.
An investigation could punish innocent employees if records were read carelessly.
The archive staff could be frightened into handing over their letters without review.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「檔案室員工可能因恐嚇而未經複核就交出信件」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

title: The First Public Return
zh: 第一件歸還公眾的物品

paragraphs.en: Mei decided to adopt a simple agency rule for the growing archive: nobody could sign a claim on behalf of someone else without written permission. She had watched how frightened behavior could be mistaken for agreement. Tao helped decorate the counter with paper stars, while Han removed an old decoration that covered the notice of review rights. Mei wanted people to cherish their possessions, but she cared even more about their power to say no. That distinction seemed fundamental. A beautiful display was useless if visitors did not know what choice they were making.
paragraphs.zh: 陳玫決定替逐漸擴大的檔案館採用一項簡單代理規則：沒有書面授權，誰都不能替別人簽署申領單。她已看過人們如何把驚恐的反應誤認成同意。陶陶替櫃檯貼上紙星星，韓叔則拆掉遮住複核權利公告的舊裝飾。陳玫希望大家珍惜物品，但她更在意每個人都有說不的能力。這個差別非常根本。若訪客根本不知道自己在作什麼選擇，再美的展示也沒有意義。

paragraphs.en: The first public hearing was held in the room once used for a student congress. A respected business owner argued that free transfers would improve trade and make the district influential. Others worried that refusing the game would discourage investment. Mei did not deny those concerns. She presented the actual interaction between three tickets: the piano, the dog's collar, and the bakery door. All had been marked unclaimed while their users were present. The outcome depended not on speed but on whether independent evidence was accepted before midnight. The suggestion that a family could lose its own bell without notice continued to horrify Tao.
paragraphs.zh: 第一場公開聽證會在曾舉辦學生代表大會的房間舉行。一位受敬重的企業主主張，自由移轉有利交易，也能使街區更具影響力。有人擔心拒絕遊戲會打擊投資。陳玫沒有否定這些顧慮；她展示鋼琴、狗項圈和麵包店門口三張申領單彼此如何牽連。三件東西都在使用者仍在場時被標成無主。結果取決的不是誰最快，而是午夜前能否接受獨立證據。 想到一家人可能毫無預警地失去自己的鐘，這件事仍令陶陶驚恐。

paragraphs.en: A girl at the reception desk asked whether a robber could win by stealing an owner's papers. The thought horrified several people. Mei admitted the danger and explained why the archive stored photographs in separate places. Han showed the primitive carbon-copy book his father had used for decades. It lacked the brightness of the new screens, but its pages could not change without leaving marks. A visiting artist brought scenery panels from the old opera room to protect the papers from the draft. They had built a small defense out of ordinary work.
paragraphs.zh: 接待桌旁的女孩問，如果強盜偷走主人的文件，是否就能贏得申領。幾個人聽得毛骨悚然。陳玫承認風險，解釋檔案館為何把照片副本存放在不同地點。韓叔拿出父親用了數十年的原始複寫簿。它沒有新螢幕耀眼，卻不能不留痕跡地更改。來訪的藝術家搬來舊歌劇廳的布景板，替文件擋風。他們靠普通工作建立了一道小小防線。

paragraphs.en: The gray-badged man returned with a claim for the town's brass bell. His accusation was shameful: he said anyone protecting public objects must be a witch or wizard using forbidden tricks. Tao trembled at the word, but Mei made him read the form. It listed no witness and no last use. The bell had sounded every noon for thirty years; dozens of people could describe it independently. The claim was rejected at the first hearing. There was no terror in the crowd this time, only relief followed by difficult questions about what might happen next.
paragraphs.zh: 戴灰徽章的男子帶著鎮上銅鐘的申領單回來。他的指控十分可恥：凡保護公共物品的人，必定是施展禁術的女巫或巫師。陶陶聽見這些詞發抖，陳玫卻請他直接讀表格。裡面沒有見證人，也沒有最近使用紀錄。這口鐘三十年來每天中午都會敲響，數十人能獨立描述其聲音。申請在第一次聽證便遭駁回。這次人群不再恐懼，只有鬆一口氣後接踵而來的難題。

paragraphs.en: A neighbor reached for the bell before the return receipt had been signed. Han caught the rope and asked him to wait. The bell's thirty years of noon use had witnesses; the rival claimant had produced none. That settled this transfer, Mei explained, but it said nothing about the other red tickets gathering at the counter. She placed a fresh review form beside each one. The neighbor put down his celebration banner and helped a woman find the date on her own notice. Only when the receipt was complete did Han release the rope for the familiar noon sound.
paragraphs.zh: 歸還收據還沒簽妥，一名鄰居就伸手要拉鐘。韓叔握住繩子，請他等一下。這座鐘三十年來中午使用都有見證人，另一位申領者卻一個也沒提出。陳玫說，這能解決這次移轉，卻不能處理櫃檯上其他紅色申領單。她在每張單旁放一份新的複核表。鄰居放下慶祝布條，幫一名女子找公告日期。等到收據完整，韓叔才放開繩索，讓熟悉的午鐘響起。

paragraphs.en: After the meeting Mei checked the archive's shelves. They held sixteen claims, three frozen transfers, and one public return. No one could honestly call that a finished reform. Still, the bell belonged to its community that evening, and a written explanation of the decision hung beside it. Mei thought of her mother's warning about approval and consent. Her conscience would not let her turn an important first success into a story of total victory. She wrote a new question in the logbook: who was making the silver tickets, and why did so many of them arrive together?
paragraphs.zh: 散會後，陳玫查看檔案架，上面有十六件申領案、三件暫停移轉案，以及一件正式歸還公眾的物品。任何人都不能誠實地稱它為已完成的改革。可是當晚，鐘確實屬於共同使用它的居民，判決理由也張貼在鐘旁。陳玫想起母親對核准與同意的警告。她的良心不允許自己把重要的第一次成功說成全面勝利。她在紀錄簿寫下新問題：銀色領物單是誰製造的？為何如此密集地一起出現？

questions.question: What did the team learn from comparing sources?
options: The published tickets contradicted receipts held by ordinary families.
The bell had been used at noon for thirty years and the rival claim had no witness.
The missing-name memorial list was contradicted by a dated envelope and appointment book.
questions.explanation: 本章記錄「銅鐘三十年來每日中午使用，而對方沒有見證人」，這是有來源可以查核的事實，其餘選項不是本章的調查結果。

questions.question: What outcome was the team trying to avoid?
options: Neighbors might accept the first public victory as proof that every case was safe.
One broken device might erase the only evidence of a forgotten worker.
Hundreds of people might lose time to respond if the archive surrendered to pressure.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「鄰居可能誤把第一次勝利當成所有案件都安全」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

paragraphs.en: On the anniversary of the old station's opening, a campaign arrived to collect objects labeled "unused." Mei went to examine a clock that still guided evening workers. The station conductor assured her that it rang at a regular frequency, yet its hands showed an hour that did not exist on the public schedule. The cord behind its case was coarse and had been tied recently. Someone had devised a way to make an old clock appear abandoned at the precise moment a silver claim would be issued.
paragraphs.zh: 舊車站開站周年那天，一場徵收「閒置物品」的活動進入站內。陳玫去檢查一座仍供晚班工人看時間的鐘。列車長向她保證，鐘聲以固定頻率響起，但指針顯示的時間卻不在公開班表上。鐘殼後的繩索粗糙，最近才被人綁過。有人設計了方法，讓一座老鐘在銀色申領單發出時看起來像已被棄置。

paragraphs.en: A diligent apprentice named Sami brought the repair records. One evaluation described a mineral coating on the gears and foam around a cracked window. Another spoke of a clock supplied to the station during the last dynasty, when workers kept time by hand. Mei warned that the dates could complicate the case, because a historic object could still have modern users. Sami showed her an imitation gear on display. It resembled the original, but its teeth were too wide to fit inside the working clock. Sami was courageous enough to admit that his first calculation had been wrong. The psychology of trust interested Mei more than the clock’s decorative case.
paragraphs.zh: 勤奮的學徒薩米帶來維修紀錄。其中一份評估寫著齒輪上的礦物沉積及裂窗周圍的泡棉；另一份提到時鐘是上個王朝供給車站的，當時工人仍靠手動計時。陳玫提醒大家，年代可能讓案件更複雜，因為歷史物品也可能繼續為現代人服務。薩米指著展示櫃中的仿製齒輪：它和原件相似，齒距卻太寬，無法裝進仍在運作的鐘裡。 薩米勇敢承認首次計算錯誤。陳玫對信任心理學的興趣，甚至超過時鐘外殼的裝飾。

paragraphs.en: The station union worried about lost labor if the clock disappeared. A needy porter might miss the last train, and cleaners could be blamed for leaving early. Mei asked a psychologist who worked nearby to explain why people kept trusting a clock they knew was sometimes wrong. The answer was not stupidity. People built habits around familiar sounds, particularly when the night shift left them exhausted. Mei began to reflect on a danger the game exploited: a false record could feel true when it repeated an ordinary routine.
paragraphs.zh: 車站工會擔心，鐘若消失，勞動排班便會受到影響。需要這份工作的搬運員可能錯過末班車，清潔員也可能被誤會提早離開。陳玫請附近一位心理師解釋，為何人們明知鐘偶爾不準仍會信它。答案不是愚蠢。人們會依熟悉的聲音建立習慣，尤其夜班結束時已經疲累。陳玫開始反思遊戲利用的一種危險：錯誤紀錄只要重複日常慣例，也會讓人覺得真實。

paragraphs.en: Sami spread the timetable across a bench and put an empty square beside every scheduled ring. Mei asked the conductor to cover the silver display so that it could not guide their count. A cleaner listened from the platform; Han waited beside the clock case. They would compare their notes only after the last train. While they prepared, a porter showed Mei the departure mark on his work card. If the false extra ring remained in the record, his ordinary departure could look late. Mei copied the card with his permission and asked the union to preserve the whole shift list. Sami then followed the new cord behind the case without pulling it. One end disappeared toward the service passage, where staff could reach it after the station closed. He marked the connection on his drawing. The clock's old gears had not suddenly forgotten the timetable; somebody had given the bell a second way to sound.
paragraphs.zh: 薩米把時刻表攤在長椅上，每次預定鐘響旁都畫一格。陳玫請列車長遮住銀色顯示，免得影響計數。一名清潔員在月台聽，韓叔守在鐘殼旁；末班車離站後才比對筆記。準備時，一名搬運員給陳玫看工作卡上的離站記號。若多出的假鐘響留在紀錄裡，他正常離站也可能被說成太晚。陳玫徵得同意後抄下卡片，請工會保存整份班表。薩米沿鐘殼後的新繩索查看，沒有拉動。繩子一端通往員工關站後仍能進入的勤務通道。他在圖上標出連接處。老齒輪並非忽然忘記班表，而是有人另設了敲鐘的方法。

paragraphs.en: Han volunteered to compare the bell with the recorded station timetable, while Sami counted the actual chimes. Their two accounts did not match the public display. A worker had added an extra ring after closing, which made the clock seem to have missed its final duty. Mei entered both sequences and requested a suspension. The reviewing screen turned amber. For now the clock stayed on the wall, although someone behind the silver system was still arranging errors as carefully as another person might arrange flowers.
paragraphs.zh: 韓叔自願把鐘聲和車站紀錄的時刻表比對，薩米則實際計數。兩份結果都和公開顯示不同。有人在關站後多加了一次鐘響，使時鐘看似沒有完成最後的任務。陳玫記下兩組順序，申請暫停移轉；複核畫面變成琥珀色。時鐘暫時留在牆上，但銀色系統背後的人仍像插花一樣仔細安排各種錯誤。

questions.question: Which detail was actually checked in this chapter?
options: Separate delivery counts identified supplies that never reached the shelters.
The projected shadow vanished when the backstage lamp moved.
The station clock was made to ring after its recorded closing time.
questions.explanation: 本章記錄「車站時鐘被安排在紀錄的關站時間後敲響」，這是有來源可以查核的事實，其餘選項不是本章的調查結果。

questions.question: What consequence did Mei try to prevent?
options: Residents needed to decide the building’s future instead of leaving that choice to a game.
Night workers might lose a familiar signal and be blamed for late departures.
Families inside the flooded archive could lose both safe passage and their evidence.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「夜班工人可能失去熟悉的信號，還被怪罪晚走」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

paragraphs.en: A sudden frost covered the animal shelter, although the surrounding streets remained warm. The game marked the building as a competitor in its own contest, promising points to whoever removed its occupants fastest. Mei asked a veterinarian to analyze the temperature readings and demanded accuracy rather than a dramatic rescue story. A helicopter circled overhead without landing. Its crew warned that the shelter had an intense energy signature. The animals, however, were simply cold and frightened; the rule on the screen did not describe their needs.
paragraphs.zh: 動物收容所忽然結霜，四周街道卻依然溫暖。遊戲把建築列為自身競賽的對手，承諾誰最快移走裡面的生命，誰就能得分。陳玫請獸醫分析溫度紀錄，要求準確，而非戲劇化的救援故事。一架直升機在上空盤旋卻未降落，機組員警告收容所有強烈能量反應。然而動物只是又冷又怕；螢幕上的規則根本沒有描述牠們的需求。

paragraphs.en: The shelter manager showed Mei a diploma from her training and an old agreement promising mutual care between the city and its volunteers. She opposed handing the animals to a private collector. A frightened herd of goats pressed against the gate, while a patient mule stood apart. Tao wanted to open every pen at once, but the manager warned that a rush could injure the smaller animals. Mei asked him to adapt his plan: carry water first, then move one group through the rear corridor after counting them. A second walk around the surroundings confirmed that the ice ended at the shelter wall.
paragraphs.zh: 收容所長拿出受訓文憑，以及市府與志工承諾共同照護的舊協議。她反對把動物交給私人收藏者。一群受驚的山羊擠在門邊，一頭耐心的騾子獨自站著。陶陶想一次打開所有欄舍，所長卻說混亂會傷到較小的動物。陳玫請他調整方法：先送水，再清點後讓各群依序從後走廊離開。 再次檢查周遭環境後，他們確認冰層只延伸到收容所外牆。

paragraphs.en: The plumber who maintained the shelter found a slight leak in a warm-water pipe. Fixing it produced a remarkable reduction in the ice near the cages. That evidence mattered more than the glowing game score. A volunteer estimated that twenty percent of the animals had already been moved safely. Mei made her repeat the count and name the cages, because percentages could hide a missing life. The shelter's welfare depended on patience, not winning a race designed by an unknown observer.
paragraphs.zh: 負責維護收容所的水管工找到溫水管一處輕微漏水。修好後，籠旁的結冰顯著減少。這項證據比發亮的遊戲分數更重要。某位志工估計已有百分之二十的動物安全移走，陳玫請她重新計數、逐一列出籠號，因為百分比可能掩蓋一條失蹤的生命。收容所的福祉仰賴耐心，不是贏得一場由未知觀察者設計的競賽。

paragraphs.en: Tao carried a water pail toward the rear corridor, then stopped when two volunteers began opening pens ahead of him. He asked them to close the second gate until the first group was through. The manager counted the goats against her feeding book while the veterinarian examined the smallest animals. One volunteer held up a glowing score and urged everyone to hurry. Mei turned the screen toward the empty pen: it awarded points even before the manager confirmed that pen's occupant was safe. Tao put his pail down and helped check the pen numbers instead. At the pipe, the plumber marked the wet joint before repairing it. Mei photographed the ice line against the wall, waited, and photographed it again from the same place. The line drew back after the repair. She attached both pictures to the faulty temperature chart so the difference would remain visible when the ice itself was gone. The screen's score could not explain that change.
paragraphs.zh: 陶陶提著水桶往後走廊走，看見兩名志工搶先開欄門，便停下來。他請他們等第一群通過，再開第二道門。所長對著餵食簿清點山羊，獸醫檢查最小的動物。一名志工舉起發光分數，催大家加快。陳玫把螢幕轉向空欄：所長尚未確認裡面的動物安全，系統已加分。陶陶放下水桶，改幫忙核對欄號。水管工先標出潮濕接頭，才動手修理。陳玫拍下牆邊冰線，等候後又從同一處再拍。修理之後，冰線退了。她把兩張照片附在錯誤溫度圖旁，讓冰消失後仍看得到差異。螢幕分數無法解釋這個變化。

paragraphs.en: Two independent records showed that the shelter had never been abandoned: a feeding ledger and the plumber's repair receipt. The silver claim froze at sunset. Tao watched the mule settle in a dry pen and understood why the slowest animal could sometimes reveal the safest plan. Mei took no prize from the game. She took a copy of the faulty temperature chart, for its false reading seemed connected to the clock at the station. In both places someone had changed a measurement before claiming the thing it described.
paragraphs.zh: 兩份獨立紀錄證明收容所從未被棄置：一份餵食簿、一張水管工的維修收據。銀色申領單在日落時暫停。陶陶看著騾子安穩待在乾燥欄舍，明白有時最慢的動物反而能揭露最安全的做法。陳玫沒有領取遊戲獎品，只帶走一份錯誤溫度圖的副本。那張圖和車站時鐘似乎有關：兩處都有人先改動測量，再申領測量所描述的物品。

questions.question: What fact helped the team question the game notice?
options: The ice retreated after a small water leak was repaired.
A damaged memory card named workers who had protected duplicate archive copies.
Two addresses and an obsolete shop sign appeared in the same digital application.
questions.explanation: 本章記錄「小水管漏水修復後，結冰便退去」，這是有來源可以查核的事實，其餘選項不是本章的調查結果。

questions.question: Why did the team insist on careful review?
options: A public display could become an excuse for exposing a family’s private history.
Scientists could be blamed for decisions made by executives who ignored their warning.
The smallest animals might be hurt if volunteers rushed to win points.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「若志工只顧搶分，最小的動物可能受傷」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

paragraphs.en: A distinguished craft worker named Mrs. Wu asked Mei to inspect a sewing room claimed by the game. The room had belonged to her ancestor, but Mei warned that family history alone was not defensible evidence of current ownership. Mrs. Wu accepted the point. She showed them the workshop's handwriting book, where customers had signed for alterations every week. The most recent entry was only two days old. Contrary to the silver notice, the room was neither forgotten nor empty; its tables still supported neighbors who needed their clothes repaired.
paragraphs.zh: 知名手工藝師吳太太請陳玫檢查被遊戲申領的裁縫室。這間屋子曾屬於她的祖先，陳玫提醒她，家族歷史本身還不足以作為現今所有權的可靠證據。吳太太接受了。她拿出顧客每週簽名取衣的筆跡簿，最新一筆就在兩天前。與銀色公告相反，房間並沒有被遺忘，也不是空的；這裡仍替鄰居修補需要使用的衣服。

paragraphs.en: The game had used identical pictures to suggest that two different sewing machines were one abandoned object. Mei asked a technician to equip both machines with numbered tags. The older machine had a scratch beneath its wheel and a hose connected to a steam press. The newer one lacked that mark. Wu felt guilt for not noticing earlier, but the technician said the error was designed to be confusing. A claim that involved two machines should never be treated as a single item merely because their photographs looked alike. A heavy crate nearly fell and could have crushed the newer machine. The technician called the labeling lousy, while Wu admitted she had misunderstood the photographs.
paragraphs.zh: 遊戲用了完全相同的照片，把兩台不同的縫紉機說成同一件棄置物。陳玫請技師替兩台機器裝上編號標籤。舊機器輪子下方有一道刮痕，並連著蒸氣熨燙用的軟管；新機器沒有那個痕跡。吳太太因沒早點發現而自責，技師說這個錯誤本來就是為了讓人混淆。涉及兩台機器的申領，不能只因照片相似就當成一件物品。 沉重木箱差點掉下來壓壞新機器。技師說標記做得很糟，吳太太則承認自己誤解了照片。

paragraphs.en: A customer in late pregnancy arrived for a fitting. Her visit gave the room's use a human meaning, but Mei would not treat a private medical fact as public proof. The woman offered a suggestion instead: use her dated order slip without revealing why the dress needed changes. Wu misunderstood at first and thought the woman wanted her name removed entirely. After a quiet talk, they agreed that a customer could confirm the transaction while keeping personal details hidden. Evidence did not require surrendering every secret.
paragraphs.zh: 一位懷孕後期的顧客來試穿衣服。她的來訪說明了房間的實際用途，但陳玫不願把私人健康狀況當作公開證據。女子改提建議：只使用有日期的訂單，不說明衣服為何需要修改。吳太太起初誤解，以為她連姓名也要完全刪除。談過之後，大家同意顧客能證明交易，卻保留個人細節。提供證據不等於交出所有秘密。

paragraphs.en: Wu brought the customer book to each numbered machine in turn. She could match an order with the older machine's scratched wheel, while a separate repair card identified the newer one. Mei copied the numbers onto different forms. The customer watched from the fitting screen and asked to see her own slip before it went into the public file. Wu covered the measurements and the note about pregnancy with plain paper. The date, service, and machine number remained visible. Mei invited her to check the copy and kept the covered original in Wu's locked drawer. Across the room, the technician held the disputed picture against the older machine. The scratch seemed to be on the wrong side. Rather than move either numbered tag, he walked around the table to inspect the reflecting surface behind it. Wu kept the machine still, and Mei cleared enough space for him to follow the belt's movement safely.
paragraphs.zh: 吳太太依序把顧客簿拿到兩台編號機器旁。她把一張訂單對上舊機器的刮痕輪子，另有維修卡能辨認新機器。陳玫把編號抄到不同表格。顧客在試衣屏風旁觀看，要求公開歸檔前先看自己的單據。吳太太用白紙蓋住尺寸與懷孕註記，日期、服務項目及機號仍看得見。陳玫請她核對副本，遮蓋的原件則鎖在吳太太抽屜裡。房間另一邊，技師拿爭議照片比對舊機器，刮痕似乎在錯誤的一側。他沒移動編號牌，而是繞到桌後檢查反光面。吳太太固定機器，陳玫清出空間，讓他安全追查皮帶動作。

paragraphs.en: When the machine moved, its belt gave a dull stroke against the frame. The technician followed the sound and discovered the false photograph had been taken from a mirror. The apparent riddle was less magical than it seemed: the image had been reversed before the silver ticket was issued. Mei prepared a written objection with both machine numbers. The claim paused, and Wu could launch her next class. The room would stay open while reviewers decided which copy had been changed and by whom.
paragraphs.zh: 機器轉動時，皮帶輕拍機架，發出沉悶的聲響。技師循聲檢查，發現錯誤照片其實是對著鏡子拍的。看似神祕的謎題並不那麼玄：銀色領物單發出之前，有人把影像左右翻轉。陳玫以兩台機器各自的編號提出書面異議。申領暫停了，吳太太得以開辦下一堂課。檔案審查者查明影像由誰更改之前，工作室可以繼續開門。

questions.question: Which observation belonged in the evidence record?
options: Two dated receipts proved that the public kitchen remained in use.
Two similar sewing machines had different scratches and separate customer records.
The company had collected fees to remove names from registers without legal authority.
questions.explanation: 本章記錄「兩台相似縫紉機有不同刮痕，也有各自的顧客紀錄」，這是有來源可以查核的事實，其餘選項不是本章的調查結果。

questions.question: What concern shaped the team’s decision?
options: A customer should not have to publish her private life to confirm an order.
The team could contaminate the evidence by opening a sealed cabinet without witnesses.
The council might promise too much and create another system no one could question.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「顧客不該為證明訂單而公開私生活」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

paragraphs.en: Mei visited a readers' association after a silver ticket appeared on a publisher's warehouse. A bald editor gave her an autobiography written by the company's founder, who had once operated a printing press beside a fireplace. The book included a quotation from the first city archive charter. Mei's curiosity rose when she noticed that one page number jumped forward by two. The editor said a vacant shelf had appeared in the warehouse at the same moment. No one could declare that an empty shelf proved a book had never existed.
paragraphs.zh: 出版社倉庫出現銀色申領單後，陳玫去拜訪讀者協會。一名禿頭編輯交給她出版社創辦人所寫的自傳；當年創辦人曾在壁爐旁操作印刷機。書中引用了最早的城市檔案章程。陳玫發現頁碼突然跳過兩頁，頓時好奇起來。編輯說倉庫也在同一時刻出現空架。不能因書架空了，就宣稱那本書從未存在。

paragraphs.en: The city's weather forecast predicted rain, so the warehouse manager ordered a halt to moving cartons outside. A rusty piece of machinery stood near a delivery door, beside a box of pasta donated to night workers. Mei spotted an invoice for a lobster-shaped paperweight, a foolish purchase that nevertheless had a complete date and receipt. The less remarkable books had no such trail. Someone had removed the shipment list and left only objects unlikely to be claimed. The consequence was plain: missing records made useful things appear unused. New problems could arise if the publisher became dependent on a single missing ledger.
paragraphs.zh: 天氣預報說即將下雨，倉庫經理下令暫停把紙箱搬到室外。送貨門旁放著生鏽的機械，還有捐給夜班工人的義大利麵箱。陳玫注意到一張龍蝦造型紙鎮的發票；雖是古怪的採購，日期和收據倒很齊全。那些普通書籍反而沒有相同紀錄。有人移除了出貨清單，只留下不太會遭申領的東西。結果很明顯：紀錄一缺，仍有用途的物件便看似閒置。 如果出版社過度依賴唯一一本失蹤帳簿，就可能出現新問題。

paragraphs.en: A minister's portrait hung above the door, and a notice warned employees not to violate storage regulations. Mei found a different problem: the public review board had a vacancy where the readers' representative should sit. The editor thought the consequent delay would allow the game to take the whole warehouse at midnight. Mei requested that the association appoint a temporary witness and restore the missing page by comparing two legal copies. They could prove a page had been removed without pretending to know what it said.
paragraphs.zh: 門上掛著部長肖像，旁邊的公告警告員工不得違反倉儲規定。陳玫發現另一個問題：公共複核委員會原本屬於讀者代表的席次空缺了。編輯擔心隨之而來的拖延，會讓遊戲在午夜收走整座倉庫。陳玫請協會推派臨時見證人，再用兩份合法副本比對，復原缺頁的順序。他們可以證明頁面遭到取走，卻不能假裝知道上面原本寫什麼。

paragraphs.en: The editor took down two older public copies and opened them beside the founder's book. The same pair of numbers was absent from each printed sequence. Mei held the pages toward the window to check for torn edges, but the paper was intact. Whatever had happened to the text had entered the copies before these books were bound. She asked the editor to mark which editions they had examined and leave the missing words blank. Outside the office, a worker was already tying string around books that the game might collect. Mei asked him to keep the cartons under the roof until the warehouse review was decided. Readers had ordered those books; a vanished shipment entry did not cancel their requests. The editor fetched the current order slips, and the temporary witness counted the waiting cartons against them. They could defend the warehouse's present work while searching separately for the older damage to its records.
paragraphs.zh: 編輯拿下兩份較早的公共副本，與創辦人的書並排翻開。每份印刷頁碼都缺同一對數字。陳玫把紙朝窗舉起，檢查撕裂邊緣，但紙張完整。文字無論如何受損，都在這些書裝訂前就進了副本。她請編輯標出查閱版本，缺字維持空白。辦公室外，一名工人正把遊戲可能收走的書綁好。陳玫請他在倉庫複核完成前，把紙箱留在屋簷下。讀者訂了這些書，出貨登記不見，不代表訂單取消。編輯取來現行訂單，臨時見證人據此清點待運紙箱。他們能維護倉庫目前的工作，同時另查較早的檔案損害。

paragraphs.en: The editor found a carbon copy with the missing numbers, but the text had been blacked out years before the game appeared. Mei entered the finding as a limit, not a solution. The silver transfer was suspended because the warehouse's current use was clear. Yet the blank pages suggested that someone had been preparing the method for a long time. As rain struck the roof, Mei wondered whether her mother's missing registration had been handled in the same way: not by making a person vanish, but by making every official path to her records lead to a blank space.
paragraphs.zh: 編輯找出帶有缺失頁碼的複寫本，但文字早在遊戲出現前多年就被塗黑。陳玫把這項發現登記為限制，而不是答案。倉庫目前的使用情況明確，銀色移轉因而暫停；可空白頁顯示，或許有人很久以前就在準備這套做法。雨滴敲著屋頂，陳玫不禁想，母親的登記失蹤是否也是如此：不是讓人消失，而是讓每條通往她紀錄的官方路徑都指向空白。

questions.question: Which finding mattered to the investigation?
options: The postage record carried a name missing from the official list.
The final rejection message conflicted with the two-witness rule on every ticket.
The same page numbers were missing from older printed copies.
questions.explanation: 編輯比對較早的印刷本，發現相同頁碼缺失；後來找到的複寫本則有頁碼但文字遭塗黑。

questions.question: What risk made the review important?
options: Visitors might admire the exhibition yet fail to understand review rights.
Readers might lose books because absence of a record was treated as abandonment.
A letter from Mei’s mother could not erase the years they had lived apart.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「讀者可能只因紀錄不見，就被當成放棄書籍」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

paragraphs.en: The municipal hall opened its first formal hearing on the Inventory. The atmosphere was tense, but Mei was determined to give each person a fair option to speak. An ambitious official wanted acceptance of every automatic claim as the default. Mei brought authentic copies of receipts and asked reviewers to classify objects by current use rather than the age of their labels. Two workers described the same facility differently. Their accounts could differ without either witness lying, she argued. A genuine investigation had to preserve that difference instead of turning it into an insult.
paragraphs.zh: 市政廳召開清冊遊戲的首次正式聽證會。氣氛緊張，陳玫仍堅持讓每個人都有公平發言的選項。一名野心勃勃的官員要求預設接受所有自動申領。陳玫帶來真正的收據副本，請審查者依現有用途而非標籤年代分類物品。兩名工人對同一設施的描述不同，她說這不代表其中一人必定說謊。真正的調查應保留差異，而非把差異變成侮辱。

paragraphs.en: A publisher testified that his promotion campaign had been interrupted when books were wrongly taken. A refugee family described how a donated coat had disappeared from their room. The mother remembered its perfume, while her daughter remembered the bright stocking tucked into a pocket. Neither detail was enough alone, but together they explained the coat's history. Mei was embarrassed when a clerk read the family's private address aloud. She stopped him and requested that addresses be sealed. Human dignity did not become less important simply because the game demanded evidence. They hoped to transform the hearing into a place where ordinary witnesses could be heard.
paragraphs.zh: 出版社代表作證說，書籍遭錯誤取走後，原定的宣傳活動被迫中斷。一戶難民家庭描述有人從住處拿走捐贈的大衣。母親記得衣上的香水味，女兒則記得口袋裡塞著鮮亮的長襪。單一細節不足以證明全部，合起來卻能說出大衣的來歷。職員當眾唸出家庭地址時，陳玫感到難堪，立刻要求密封住址。遊戲要求證據，也不能因此降低人的尊嚴。 大家希望把聽證會轉變成平凡見證人也能被聽見的地方。

paragraphs.en: The official called the public archive offensive and asked for Mei's resignation. She refused to make the hearing about her job. Instead she read the three printed review rules and explained why every silver ticket had to be tested against them. The hall had been designed for speeches, not the rescue of ordinary things, but neighbors brought their own dated records. Even officials who disliked Mei could see that her argument relied on checkable facts. The review board granted the archive thirty days to submit independent evidence on all disputed transfers.
paragraphs.zh: 那名官員稱公共檔案館令人反感，還要求陳玫辭職。她拒絕讓聽證會變成自己的職位爭議，轉而朗讀三條明文複核規則，說明每張銀色領物單都得受其檢驗。這座議事廳原本供人演說，而不是拯救平凡物品，但居民紛紛帶來有日期的紀錄。即使不喜歡陳玫的官員，也能看出她的論點有可查驗的事實。審查會給檔案館三十天，整理所有爭議移轉的獨立證據。

paragraphs.en: The clerk brought the printed tickets to the witnesses' table. Mei placed the family's donation receipt beside the coat notice and the publisher's delivery slips beside the warehouse claim. In each pair, a dated transaction contradicted the label 'unused.' The official asked to circulate the originals through the gallery. Mei pointed to the address still visible on the coat receipt and requested a covered copy instead. The chair ordered the clerk to record that request before continuing. A woman in the audience asked whether she could submit evidence without speaking her address into the hall. The clerk prepared a sealed envelope for her identifying details, then read only the transaction date aloud. Mei watched the process rather than the official's expression. If the thirty-day extension depended on exposing every household, many of the people who needed it would never come forward. The public evidence could travel around the room while the private information stayed with its authorized keeper.
paragraphs.zh: 書記把印出的申領單送到證人桌。陳玫把家庭的捐贈收據放在外套公告旁，把出版社的送貨單放在倉庫申領旁。每一組都有附日期交易，反駁「閒置」標籤。官員要求把原件傳給旁聽席，陳玫指著外套收據上仍露出的地址，要求改傳遮蓋副本。議長命書記先記下要求，再繼續。觀眾席一名女子問，能否不公開唸出住址也提交證據。書記準備密封信封保存身分資料，只朗讀交易日期。陳玫看著程序，沒看官員表情。若三十天延期得靠每家揭露私事，很多需要的人根本不會出面。公開證據可以在室內傳閱，私人資料則留在授權保管者手裡。

paragraphs.en: Outside the hall, Tao asked why a victory could feel like a loss. Mei said the hearing had not returned every object. It had only forced the game to wait while people checked its claims. Still, that waiting mattered. The archive now had a legal place to keep evidence, and the families had time to speak for themselves. Mei wrote down the deadline with a trembling hand. She had traded the comfort of a quick answer for a harder promise: before the next midnight, she would learn who had taught the city to mistake a missing label for an abandoned life.
paragraphs.zh: 議事廳外，陶陶問為何勝利還能讓人覺得失落。陳玫說，聽證沒有歸還所有東西，只是迫使遊戲等待大家核對。但等待本身很重要。檔案館現在有合法地方保存證據，家庭也有時間替自己說話。陳玫手微微發抖，寫下期限。她用簡單答案換了一個艱難承諾：下個午夜前，她要查出是誰教城市把失去標籤的東西誤認為遭人放棄的生活。

questions.question: What did the team learn from comparing sources?
options: The published tickets contradicted receipts held by ordinary families.
The payment ledger named charges for editing public labels before the game began.
A false safety button demanded legal surrender without fixing the electrical danger.
questions.explanation: 本章記錄「公開票券與平凡家庭保存的收據互相矛盾」，這是有來源可以查核的事實，其餘選項不是本章的調查結果。

questions.question: What outcome was the team trying to avoid?
options: Mei might mistake hope for proof that her mother wished to return.
The music teacher could lose a free classroom that six families depended on.
Private addresses could be exposed if the hearing favored speed over care.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「若聽證只求速度，私人地址可能遭曝光」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

paragraphs.en: A hurricane struck the outer harbor while the city debated the Inventory. An official used the chaos to accuse the public archive of blocking relief commerce. He boasted that a private company could manufacture supplies faster than volunteers. Mei asked for assurance that donated materials would reach the families named on the shipping lists. The company offered a polished convention of signatures but no consistent delivery records. Without those records, the game could declare a shipment unused the moment it crossed a warehouse door.
paragraphs.zh: 颶風襲擊外港時，城裡還在辯論清冊遊戲。一名官員趁混亂指控公共檔案館阻礙救災物資交易，誇耀私人公司比志工更能快速生產用品。陳玫要求保證：捐贈物資必須送到出貨清單上列出的家庭。公司拿出一套漂亮的簽名慣例，卻沒有一致的交貨紀錄。沒有交貨證明，遊戲就能在貨物通過倉庫門口時把它判作無人使用。

paragraphs.en: A scientist delivered an informative note about a damaged hydrogen tank on the pier. Mei did not pretend to understand its engineering, so she sent it to the emergency crew. The crew called the risk troublesome but manageable if nobody touched the equipment. Han carried drinking water to a shelter beneath a skyscraper. A loyal shopkeeper offered to contribute blankets. The disaster was real; it did not need a false game notice to become frightening. Mei wanted to expose the paperwork trick without delaying help to people who were already cold.
paragraphs.zh: 一位科學家送來說明碼頭氫氣槽受損的資料。陳玫沒有假裝理解工程細節，而是把資訊交給緊急救援隊。隊員說風險麻煩，但只要無人碰設備就能管理。韓叔把飲用水送往摩天大樓下的避難所，忠實的店主也願意捐出毛毯。災害本來就真實，不必靠假的遊戲公告製造恐懼。陳玫想揭露文件手法，卻不能因此延誤受寒者的救援。

paragraphs.en: Ignorance would have been easy to hide behind official titles. Instead Mei asked the shelter nurses to keep their own receipts. The supplies arrived in four loads, and each person receiving a box wrote the date and quantity. The records could not prevent every misfortune, but they allowed recovery to be checked later. The company could not simply claim its trucks had delivered everything. The nurses showed resistance when a manager tried to collect all the records. They handed him copies and kept the originals in a dry cupboard.
paragraphs.zh: 官職很容易成為掩蓋無知的盾牌。陳玫反而請避難所護理師自行保存收據。物資分四批送達，每位收箱的人都記下日期與數量。紀錄不能阻止所有不幸，卻能讓之後的復原工作有跡可查。公司不能只說貨車已送完一切。經理要收走所有文件時，護理師提出抵抗：她們只交副本，把原件保存在乾燥櫃子裡。

paragraphs.en: At the shelter door, Han found a nurse comparing her receipt with the driver's list. The numbers differed. They counted the stacked water boxes again without consulting each other's totals, then called the second receiving team. That team had also signed for fewer boxes than the shipping office claimed to have sent. Mei made a copy of each count and left the drinking water where families could reach it. She would not hold the supplies while the company argued over its ledger. A manager tried to place a silver collection ticket on the blankets, pointing to the missing delivery record. The nurse opened the dry cupboard and produced her own original. Han kept the cupboard door clear while Mei asked the manager to name the loads he had personally seen. He could not account for the missing boxes. The new discrepancy went into the relief record with the driver's statement attached, so emergency crews could trace it without interrupting the shelter's next distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 收容站門口，韓叔看見護士正拿收據與司機清單比對，數量不同。他們不看彼此總數，重新清點堆好的飲用水箱，再聯絡第二個收貨小組。那組簽收的箱數，也比運送辦公室宣稱出貨的少。陳玫各留一份副本，飲用水仍放在家庭取用得到的地方；公司爭論帳簿時，她不會扣住物資。經理指著缺失送貨紀錄，想把銀色收取單貼到毛毯上。護士打開乾燥櫥櫃，拿出自己的原件。韓叔保持櫃門暢通，陳玫則請經理說出親眼見過哪幾車。他無法交代缺少的箱子。新的數量差異連同司機證詞一起歸入救濟紀錄，讓緊急人員追查時，不致妨礙下一次發放。

paragraphs.en: At midnight the game tried to transfer the remaining blankets to the company. Mei presented two independent counts from the shelter and the delivery crew. The transfer froze. She went home without the relaxation she had promised herself, but the public record now showed which boxes had arrived and which were still missing. Tao asked whether the storm had made their work more important. Mei answered that it had made their mistakes more costly. A careful archive should protect people during an emergency, not turn their fear into an opportunity for someone else.
paragraphs.zh: 午夜時，遊戲試圖把剩餘毛毯移轉給公司。陳玫提出避難所和送貨隊各自製作的清點紀錄，移轉便暫停了。她回家時沒能得到原本答應自己的休息，但公共紀錄已能指出哪些箱子送達、哪些仍不見蹤影。陶陶問風暴是否讓工作更重要。陳玫說，風暴讓錯誤的代價更大。謹慎的檔案館應在緊急時保護人，而非把人們的恐懼變成他人的機會。

questions.question: Which detail was actually checked in this chapter?
options: The gallery displayed disputed objects separately from their changing labels.
Separate delivery counts identified supplies that never reached the shelters.
An old incident report warned that usage prediction was not ownership evidence.
questions.explanation: 本章記錄「不同單位的交貨清點指出有物資根本沒到避難所」，這是有來源可以查核的事實，其餘選項不是本章的調查結果。

questions.question: What consequence did Mei try to prevent?
options: A paperwork dispute could delay drinking water during a real storm.
A blackout could make people surrender valuable records in panic.
Tao would have to decide whether to let strangers see his family’s private photographs.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「文件爭議可能在真正風暴時延誤飲用水」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

paragraphs.en: The archive's old hardware began to fail after the storm. A hawk perched outside the window while Mei and Nila checked the distribution of their backup files. The board demanded absolute accuracy, but the pair understood that perfection was unrealistic. They fastened paper labels to every storage box and practiced a simple discipline: enter each correction once, then ask another person to read it aloud. Mei inserted a damaged memory card into a reader and found a faded illustration of an oval ship carrying a public collection across the river.
paragraphs.zh: 風暴後，檔案館的舊硬體開始故障。一隻鷹停在窗外，陳玫和妮拉則檢查備份檔案的分布。系統要求絕對準確，但兩人明白完美並不現實。她們在每個儲存箱上固定紙標籤，練習簡單的紀律：每項更正只輸入一次，再由另一人讀出核對。陳玫把受損記憶卡插進讀卡機，找到一幅褪色插圖，畫著橢圓形的船載著公共館藏渡河。

paragraphs.en: The vessel in the picture had belonged to a miner's cooperative. A gracious elderly boatman still remembered its final crossing. He had carried boxes of books to the municipal archive, not sold them. His story offered recognition to workers whose names had been left out of the official transfer list. Mei felt grief when she saw her mother's initials in the margin. She had dreaded finding evidence of betrayal, but the initials showed only that her mother had received the boxes. They did not explain where she had gone. A realistic plan allowed for failed devices and forgotten passwords.
paragraphs.zh: 圖中的船屬於礦工合作社。一位和善的老船夫仍記得最後一次渡河。他載的是要送進市立檔案室的書箱，並沒有出售。這段敘述讓那些未被列在官方移轉清單上的工人重新獲得辨認。看到母親在頁邊留下的姓名縮寫時，陳玫感到悲傷。她一直害怕找到背叛的證據，但縮寫只能證明母親收過箱子，無法說明她後來去了哪裡。 現實可行的計畫必須考慮設備故障與密碼遭遺忘的情況。

paragraphs.en: Nila proposed that they renew the independent copy system rather than abandon it for a faster device. Speed was useful, but efficiency meant little if one failure could erase both copies at once. They resolved to keep one set at the museum and another at the riverside school. Mei drew a clear chart of the route, then invited the boatman to correct her assumptions. He changed two dates and refused to guess at a third. That refusal made the evidence stronger, because every blank space was visible instead of hidden.
paragraphs.zh: 妮拉主張更新雙份獨立副本制度，而不是為了更快的設備把它丟掉。速度有用，但若一次故障便能抹去兩份資料，效率也失去意義。兩人決定一份放博物館，另一份存河邊學校。陳玫畫出清楚的路線圖，請船夫修正她的假設。船夫改了兩個日期，第三個則拒絕猜測。這種拒絕讓證據更有力量，因為空白被保留下來，而不是遭到掩蓋。

paragraphs.en: The reader made a clicking sound and the ship picture broke into gray squares. Mei took her hand off the card at once. Nila wrote down the error message, then asked the schoolteacher to bring the paper transfer list instead of trying the card repeatedly. The boatman leaned over that list and recognized the names of two workers who had carried boxes beside him. Mei recorded his corrections on a separate sheet, keeping the damaged image unchanged. They could not risk losing the workers a second time to a failed device. Han took the first paper copy to the museum while the teacher prepared a dry shelf at the school. Before they separated, Nila read both destination labels aloud and Mei compared them with the route chart. The eagle outside lifted away as the boatman pointed across the river toward the landing. His account now had a place in two buildings, where neither a broken reader nor a missing password could erase it alone.
paragraphs.zh: 讀卡機喀喀響，船的圖像裂成灰色方格。陳玫立刻把手移開。妮拉記下錯誤訊息，請學校老師帶來紙本移轉清單，不再反覆測試記憶卡。船夫俯身看清單，認出兩名曾和他一起搬箱的工人。陳玫把他的更正記在另一張紙上，受損影像保持原狀。他們不能讓故障設備再使工人失去一次姓名。韓叔把第一份紙本送去博物館，老師在學校準備乾燥書架。分開前，妮拉唸出兩份目的地標籤，陳玫與路線圖比對。窗外的鷹飛走，船夫指向河對岸碼頭。他的說法如今存於兩棟建築，單靠讀卡機損壞或密碼遺忘，無法一併抹去。

paragraphs.en: That night a silver notice tried to claim the damaged memory card as electronic waste. The schoolteacher and Nila filed separate statements about its use. The transfer paused. More important, Mei now had evidence that her mother had once designed the very safeguard the Inventory was struggling to defeat. The memory card contained no hidden weapon, only a list of ordinary people who had agreed to keep one another's records safe. Mei copied their names carefully. They might be the missing witnesses she needed later.
paragraphs.zh: 當晚，銀色公告試圖把受損記憶卡當成電子廢棄物申領。學校教師與妮拉各自提交使用證明，移轉暫停。更重要的是，陳玫終於有證據顯示，母親曾參與設計清冊遊戲正企圖突破的保護措施。記憶卡沒有藏武器，只有一串平凡人的姓名；他們曾答應互相保存紀錄。陳玫仔細抄下名字。未來需要見證人時，也許就得靠這些人。

questions.question: What fact helped the team question the game notice?
options: The missing-name memorial list was contradicted by a dated envelope and appointment book.
The original charter required actual use and independent witnesses.
A damaged memory card named workers who had protected duplicate archive copies.
questions.explanation: 本章記錄「受損記憶卡列有曾保護雙份檔案的工人姓名」，這是有來源可以查核的事實，其餘選項不是本章的調查結果。

questions.question: Why did the team insist on careful review?
options: Patients could lose a functioning clinic or have their medical privacy exposed.
One broken device might erase the only evidence of a forgotten worker.
The tunnel might be closed forever if its recent users stayed silent.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「一台故障裝置可能抹去被遺忘工人唯一的證據」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

paragraphs.en: A neighborhood conference met beside the foundation of an abandoned public kitchen. Wild flowers had begun to blossom between the stones. Children from a local choir sang an old tune while Mei explained the plan to preserve voices recorded by earlier generations. A retired teacher spoke of a legend that the kitchen carried a curse: anyone who forgot its recipes would become miserable. Mei asked people not to mistake the legend for a rule. The kitchen had once fulfilled a practical need, and that use could be proved without believing a magical threat.
paragraphs.zh: 一場社區會議在廢棄公共廚房的地基旁舉行。石縫間開著野花，地方合唱團的孩子唱起舊曲。陳玫說明要保存前幾代人留下的聲音紀錄。一位退休教師提到傳說：忘掉廚房食譜的人會受詛咒，一生悲慘。陳玫請大家別把傳說當成規則。廚房以前確實滿足過實際需求，而這點無須相信魔法威脅也能證明。

paragraphs.en: An economics student presented a proposal for using the site as a meeting place again. He offered to sketch a kitchen with wide doors and a striped awning, but his cost estimate scarcely included water or staff. Mei asked him to summarize what his numbers meant for the people who would work there. He accepted the criticism and requested an appointment with the old kitchen manager. Their conversation was leisurely, with long pauses that gave the older woman time to remember which supplies came from the city and which from neighbors. The choir repeated its final chorus as the audience entered the old kitchen yard.
paragraphs.zh: 一名經濟系學生提出重新利用這處場地作為聚會場所的方案，還畫出寬門和條紋遮棚的廚房草圖。但他的預算幾乎沒算進水費與員工薪資。陳玫請他總結這些數字對實際工作者意味著什麼。他接受批評，預約和舊廚房經理見面。談話進行得很從容，停頓很長，讓長者能慢慢想起哪些物資來自市府、哪些由鄰居提供。 觀眾走進舊廚房庭院時，合唱團又唱了一遍最後的副歌。

paragraphs.en: One memorable recording described how the kitchen had carried oxygen cylinders during a citywide fire. The cylinders were returned afterward, and the manager kept two receipts. She said the kitchen's meaning was universal: people needed food and a safe room, whatever their background. Mei did not need to prove that every generation loved the same building. She only needed clear evidence that it had remained in use after the date printed on the silver claim. The receipts did exactly that, and the transfer was suspended.
paragraphs.zh: 一段令人難忘的錄音說，當年全城火災時，廚房還曾暫時保管氧氣瓶。瓶子後來歸還，經理保留兩張收據。她說廚房的意義十分普遍：不論背景，人們都需要食物和安全空間。陳玫無須證明每一代都喜歡同一棟建築；她只要提出明確證據，證明銀色申領單列出的日期之後，這裡仍有人使用。收據辦到了，移轉再次暫停。

paragraphs.en: The old manager unfolded the two receipts on a stone beside the kitchen door. A former delivery worker identified the return date on one; the student checked that it followed the abandonment date on the game notice. He had come with a drawing for a new meeting room, but now turned the paper over to list water, wages, and access costs. Several neighbors wanted the old stove kept, while others wanted more space for wheelchairs. Mei drew no winning design. She asked the student to record both requests and bring a revised estimate to the next neighborhood meeting. The choir children helped weight the papers against the breeze with clean stones. One child asked to hear the oldest recording again. The manager carried the player out of the doorway, away from the people inspecting the receipts, and Mei followed. Saving the site had given them time to discuss its future; it had not chosen that future for them.
paragraphs.zh: 舊經理在廚房門旁的石頭上攤開兩張收據。以前的送貨員認出其中一張的歸還日期，學生核對後，確認晚於遊戲公告所稱的棄置日期。他本來帶著新聚會室圖稿，如今把紙翻面，列出水費、工資與出入費用。有鄰居要留舊爐灶，也有人要替輪椅騰出空間。陳玫沒畫出勝選方案，而是請學生記下兩種要求，下次社區會議帶修正估價來。合唱團孩子用乾淨石塊壓住紙，免被風吹走。一名孩子想重聽最早錄音。經理把播放器搬離門口與查收據的人，陳玫跟了過去。保住場地讓居民有時間討論未來，並未替他們選定未來。

paragraphs.en: A boy asked whether saving a building meant it must stay unchanged forever. Mei said no. Returning a public object did not mean refusing all new ideas. The people who used a place could choose to rebuild it, but the choice should not be made by a stranger collecting points. Before leaving, Mei listened to one final recording. A woman's voice mentioned the name of an older archive committee, and Mei recognized the voice as her mother's. The recording ended before she could hear the rest of the sentence.
paragraphs.zh: 有男孩問，救下一棟建築是否代表它必須永遠保持原樣。陳玫回答不是。歸還公共物品不表示拒絕所有新想法。使用場地的人可以選擇重建，但不該由陌生人為了得分替他們決定。離開前，陳玫又聽了一段錄音。一名女子提到舊檔案委員會的名稱，陳玫聽出那是母親的聲音。錄音在她聽到下半句之前就結束了。

questions.question: Which observation belonged in the evidence record?
options: Two dated receipts proved that the public kitchen remained in use.
The projected shadow vanished when the backstage lamp moved.
The new public ticket explained missing evidence and provided a right to appeal.
questions.explanation: 本章記錄「兩張有日期的收據證明公共廚房仍在使用」，這是有來源可以查核的事實，其餘選項不是本章的調查結果。

questions.question: What concern shaped the team’s decision?
options: An investigation could punish innocent employees if records were read carelessly.
The archive staff could be frightened into handing over their letters without review.
Residents needed to decide the building’s future instead of leaving that choice to a game.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「居民應自己決定建築未來，不該把選擇交給遊戲」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

title: The Price of a Blank Name

paragraphs.en: The city council invited Mei to exhibit examples of disputed claims. She had only one acquaintance inside the building, a former clerk who gave her access to the public gallery. Outside, an aggressive campaign accused the archive of slowing the economy. Mei felt ashamed when protesters called a refugee family dishonest, but she did not answer with a personal attack. Her exhibit showed the exact formula used to count each object's last recorded use. The numbers were simple enough for visitors to check, and the missing values were left blank.
paragraphs.zh: 市議會邀陳玫展示爭議申領案例。她在大樓裡只有一位熟人，是讓她進入公共展廳的前職員。外面一場激烈活動指控檔案館拖慢經濟。抗議者罵難民家庭不誠實時，陳玫感到羞愧，但沒有以人身攻擊回應。她的展示列出每件物品最近使用時間的計算公式。數字簡單到訪客能自行核對，而缺失的數值就保留空白。

paragraphs.en: A competitive developer offered a reward to anyone who could produce more claims before sunset. An elderly woman who had chosen to immigrate decades earlier asked whether the offer included her family's old letters. The developer ignored her question. Mei was keen to speak, but Nila urged patience. Public criticism could be uncomfortable without being false. They separated disagreement about policy from a penalty imposed on people who tried to keep their own belongings. That distinction changed several council members' questions. The chair asked for tolerance when residents described events in different words.
paragraphs.zh: 一名好勝的開發商懸賞，誰能在日落前提出更多申領，誰便得到獎勵。一位數十年前選擇移居此地的老婦人問，這是否也包括她家的舊信。開發商無視她。陳玫急著發言，妮拉卻請她耐心。公開批評可能刺耳，但未必錯誤。她們把政策分歧和懲罰保護自己物品的人分開討論，這使幾名議員開始提出不同的問題。 議長請大家包容居民以不同措辭描述同一件事。

paragraphs.en: The council chair asked Mei to refer to earlier decisions rather than make a prediction about everything that might happen next. She showed the piano and bakery rulings, then a postage receipt proving an archive copy had been sent before the game began. Moreover, the receipt carried the name of a clerk who had later disappeared from the official list. Mei asked the council to hasten an inquiry into missing names, not to award her team special powers. The hearing ended with a limited order to preserve records until investigators could review them.
paragraphs.zh: 議長請陳玫參照較早的裁決，不要試圖預測接下來所有可能發生的事。她拿出鋼琴與麵包店案件，再出示一張遊戲開始前寄出檔案副本的郵資收據。更重要的是，收據上有一名後來從官方名冊消失的職員姓名。陳玫請議會加快調查失蹤姓名，而非獎賞她的小隊特權。聽證結束時，議會下令暫時保存紀錄，直到調查員能加以審查。

paragraphs.en: Before the gallery opened, a council aide asked Mei for the refugee family's original letters. The aide wanted an impressive display, with names and addresses visible. Mei set out the public ruling instead. She explained which transaction it confirmed and left a space where the family could choose whether to contribute anything more. The aide protested that a covered letter would attract less attention. Nila asked him to identify the detail that the council actually needed to check. He pointed to a date, which Mei copied onto the exhibit card. The rest stayed covered. Later a visitor traced the date from that card to the postage receipt and asked why its clerk's name was missing from the register. Mei showed him the two sources side by side. His question concerned the missing public entry, rather than a family's private history. She wrote it on the sheet of questions for the chair.
paragraphs.zh: 展廳開門前，一名議會助理向陳玫索取難民家庭的原信。他想做引人注目的展示，姓名地址都露出來。陳玫改擺公共裁決，說明它確認哪一筆交易，另留空白讓家庭決定是否多提供資料。助理抱怨遮蓋信件比較不吸睛，妮拉請他指出議會究竟需要查哪個細節。他指日期，陳玫便抄到展示卡，其餘仍遮住。後來有訪客從卡上日期查到郵資收據，問為何收據上的職員姓名不在名冊。陳玫把兩個來源並排給他看。他問的是缺失的公共登記，而非家庭私史。她把問題記到交給議長的提問單上。

paragraphs.en: On the steps outside, Tao said the public exhibit had looked too ordinary to change anything. Mei agreed that it was ordinary. The point was not to impress people with a secret power. It was to let them examine a claim without needing permission from the person who filed it. She wrote down the chair's order exactly, including the limits that disappointed her. The archive had won time again, but the missing names were no longer merely family mysteries. They were now part of the city's official investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 走出大樓時，陶陶說這場公開展覽太平凡了，似乎不足以改變什麼。陳玫同意它很平凡。目的不是靠神祕力量讓人佩服，而是讓任何人不必得到申領者允許，也能查驗申請。她逐字記下議長命令，連令她失望的限制也不省略。檔案館又爭取到時間，但缺失的姓名已不只是家庭謎團，如今成為城市正式調查的一部分。

questions.question: Which finding mattered to the investigation?
options: Two addresses and an obsolete shop sign appeared in the same digital application.
The postage record carried a name missing from the official list.
The piano pedal was worn and Thursday lesson cards were still in the drawer.
questions.explanation: 本章記錄「郵資收據上記著官方名單中消失的名字」，這是有來源可以查核的事實，其餘選項不是本章的調查結果。

questions.question: What risk made the review important?
options: A public display could become an excuse for exposing a family’s private history.
Hundreds of people might lose time to respond if the archive surrendered to pressure.
Neighbors might accept the first public victory as proof that every case was safe.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「公共展示可能成為揭露家庭私史的藉口」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

paragraphs.en: An artistic map led Mei to a circular passage under a cliff near the harbor. The map mixed old transportation lines with drawings of a submarine used for research, not war. Han called its discovery a blessing; Mei reminded him that an appealing picture was not an alternative to evidence. A retired instructor explained how early technological devices had been stored underground. The room's power socket was scratched, and its labels had been painted over with makeup from a film production. It looked abandoned, but appearances were no longer enough.
paragraphs.zh: 一張富有藝術感的地圖帶陳玫來到港口懸崖下的環形通道。圖上混合了舊交通線和一艘研究用、而非軍用的潛水艇。韓叔說發現這裡是福氣，陳玫提醒他，漂亮的圖不能取代證據。退休教官說明早期科技設備如何存放在地下。房間的插座有刮痕，標籤則被電影劇組的化妝顏料覆蓋。它看似廢棄，但外觀已不足以作準。

paragraphs.en: A recorded voice gave instructions about pronunciation because the archive's old system recognized spoken passwords. Nowadays nobody relied on that method alone. Mei's diligence paid off when she found a ledger showing regular inspections after the harbor had closed. Someone had tried to regulate access by posting an unofficial warning that visitors must retreat. Mei asked Tao not to disturb the cables while she checked who had signed the inspection sheets. Every signature came from a different person, but the authorizing stamp was identical. The faded map blended old shipping routes with newer labels, which made the seal harder to identify.
paragraphs.zh: 一段錄音教人發音，因為舊檔案系統曾靠口說密語辨識使用者。如今已沒有人只依賴這種方法。陳玫仔細查找終於有了成果：她找到一份紀錄簿，顯示港口關閉後仍定期檢查設備。有人張貼非官方警告，試圖管制進入，命令訪客撤退。陳玫請陶陶別碰電纜，自己核對檢查表上的簽名。每個簽名都不同，核准印章卻完全一樣。 褪色地圖把舊航運線和新標籤混在一起，使封印更難辨認。

paragraphs.en: The stamp carried the mark of a private publicity office, not the city archive. An inspection could be genuine even if an organization paid for it, but the payment could affect a witness's independence. Mei compared the signatures with the original employment list. Four witnesses had worked for the same company and had been told what to write. Their statements were not independent in the sense the game rule required. She did not tear up the papers. She marked the relationship and filed a challenge, leaving the reviewers to assess the evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 印章屬於私人宣傳公司，而不是市立檔案室。即使機構付費，檢查也可能真實，但付費關係可能影響見證的獨立性。陳玫把簽名和原始員工名冊比對，發現四名見證人都任職於同一家公司，而且被要求寫下指定內容。依遊戲規則，他們的說法不能算互相獨立。她沒有撕毀文件，而是標註關係、提出異議，讓審查者衡量證據。

paragraphs.en: Han reached for the cabinet catch, then stopped when Mei asked him to look at the seal first. Its corner had lifted, but the mark was still readable. She photographed that condition while Lin recorded the room and time. They asked the retired instructor to describe the cabinet before hearing what either of them expected to find. He remembered storage papers, not ownership documents. Only then did they open it in view of the witnesses. Tao waited away from the cables with the empty document sleeves. Mei slid the first payment page into one without changing the order of the stack. The dates preceded the Inventory, and the charges named edits to public labels. Han read those entries separately before Mei showed him her notes. They marked the cabinet's contents and prepared to close it again. No discovery was worth leaving the next reviewer unable to tell what the team had touched or moved.
paragraphs.zh: 韓叔伸手碰櫃扣，聽陳玫請他先看封條，就停了下來。封條一角翹起，印記仍清楚。她拍下現況，林記錄房間與時間。他們先請退休教官描述櫃子，沒讓他聽見兩人預期找到什麼。他記得存的是倉儲文件，而非所有權文件。這才在見證人眼前開櫃。陶陶拿空文件套，站在遠離電纜處。陳玫把第一張付款頁放進套子，不改整疊順序。日期早於清冊遊戲，費用項目是修改公共標籤。韓叔先自行讀條目，陳玫再給他看筆記。他們標記內容，準備重新關櫃。再大的發現，也不值得讓後來審查者分不清團隊曾碰過或移動什麼。

paragraphs.en: At the back of the room, they found a sealed cabinet with the same symbol as the letter from Mei's mother. It contained a register of payments for editing public labels, including charges made before the Inventory appeared. The record did not identify who controlled the silver system, but it showed that the errors had a price. Mei took dated photographs, closed the cabinet, and asked Han to witness the seal. For the first time she could connect the missing names, false measurements, and automatic transfers to a single business arrangement.
paragraphs.zh: 房間深處有個密封櫃，符號與陳玫母親信上的相同。裡面是修改公共標籤的付款簿，連清冊遊戲出現前的費用都列著。紀錄尚未指出誰控制銀色系統，卻顯示錯誤是有人付錢造成的。陳玫拍下有日期的照片，關好櫃子，請韓叔見證封條。她第一次能把缺失姓名、錯誤測量和自動移轉連結到同一套商業安排。

questions.question: What did the team learn from comparing sources?
options: The company had collected fees to remove names from registers without legal authority.
The collar had a damaged bell loop that matched the grandmother’s account.
The payment ledger named charges for editing public labels before the game began.
questions.explanation: 本章記錄「付款簿記著遊戲出現前便有人付費修改公共標籤」，這是有來源可以查核的事實，其餘選項不是本章的調查結果。

questions.question: What outcome was the team trying to avoid?
options: Families inside the flooded archive could lose both safe passage and their evidence.
The team could contaminate the evidence by opening a sealed cabinet without witnesses.
Night workers might lose a familiar signal and be blamed for late departures.
questions.explanation: 本章顯示「團隊若沒有見證人就打開封存櫃，可能污染證據」可能造成實際影響，所以主角堅持保存證據與複核權利。

paragraphs.en: The old art gallery became the archive's temporary headquarters. Mei arranged each disputed item in a clear container, with its label, date, and current custodian shown separately. A lecturer from the university warned that visitors could become an addict to the game's glowing rewards without noticing the cost. Mei agreed about the danger but disliked turning every player into a villain. One important aspect of the exhibit was to distinguish deliberate fraud from an ordinary mistake. The display would offer partial answers openly rather than pretend every case had already been solved.
paragraphs.zh: 舊美術館成了檔案館的臨時總部。陳玫把每件爭議物品放在透明容器中，分別標明標籤、日期和目前保管人。大學講師提醒，遊客可能沉迷遊戲發光的獎勵，而忽略代價。陳玫同意這個風險，卻不喜歡把每位玩家都當成壞人。展覽的重要面向之一，就是區分蓄意欺騙和一般失誤。展覽會坦白提供部分答案，而非假裝所有案件已解決。

paragraphs.en: On opening day, a flea jumped from an old coat as a child leaned over a display. Outside, a hive of bees had formed under a window. The caretaker knelt to examine a loose door knob and asked everyone to move back. A volunteer wanted to sprinkle water on the hive; a beekeeper told him not to disturb it. Above the roof a telescope pointed toward the stars, a reminder that the gallery had once hosted astronomy nights. The building's uses had changed, but none had required strangers to seize its contents. To read the oldest label, Nila had to kneel beside the shelf. She named the two safeguards, namely paper copies and independent witnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 開幕當天，一名孩子探看展示時，舊外套跳出一隻跳蚤。窗外有蜂群築起的蜂巢。管理員跪下檢查鬆動的門把，請大家退後。有志工想往蜂巢灑水，養蜂人請他別打擾。屋頂上的望遠鏡指向星空，提醒大家美術館以前還曾舉辦天文夜。建築的用途雖然改變，卻從不需要陌生人來沒收裡面的東西。 妮拉必須跪在架旁才能讀到最舊標籤。她點出兩項保障，也就是紙本副本與獨立見證人。

paragraphs.en: Nila planned an intensive session on document preservation. Her main point was simple: a label and a thing are not the same object. A label could be copied; a thing might have wear, history, and people attached to it. Students wrote short notes after each demonstration. One boy said the work was less exciting than a celebration, but far more promising than another contest for points. Mei thanked him for being respectful toward those whose belongings were on display. She wanted visitors to feel responsible, not entertained by somebody else's loss.
paragraphs.zh: 妮拉安排了一場密集的文件保存課程。她的核心觀念很簡單：標籤和物品不是同一件事。標籤可以複製，物品卻有磨損、歷史以及與它有關的人。學生每看完一次示範就寫短筆記。一名男孩說，這工作不像慶祝活動般刺激，卻比另一場搶分競賽更有前途。陳玫感謝他尊重展示物的原主人。她希望訪客感到責任，而不是把別人的失去當成娛樂。

paragraphs.en: A visitor pointed at a faded ticket and asked whether it belonged to the coat or the glass case around it. Mei invited him to read the three separate cards: the object's description, the game's claim, and the custodian's receipt. He had assumed they were one label. Nila moved the cards farther apart and gave him a blank example to complete. He could describe the coat but did not know its last use, so he left that line empty. A student beside him wanted to fill it from memory of a different display. Mei asked her to compare the case numbers first. They did not match. The visitor crossed out his first attempt and started again without losing his place in the session. By the end he could explain why seeing an object in the gallery did not make it available to claim. Mei kept his confusing first form to help improve the next demonstration.
paragraphs.zh: 一名訪客指著褪色申領單，問它屬於外套，還是外面的玻璃櫃。陳玫請他讀三張分開的卡：物品描述、遊戲申領及保管收據。他原以為是同一個標籤。妮拉把卡移遠些，給他一份空白範例填寫。他能描述外套，卻不知道最近用途，便留白。旁邊一名學生想憑另一件展品的記憶補上，陳玫請她先比對櫃號，號碼不符。訪客劃掉第一次填答，重新開始，仍能繼續參加課程。結束時，他能解釋物品展示於館內不代表可以申領。陳玫留著他第一份混淆的表格，作為改進下次示範的依據。
